name: SoundCloud New Tracks
description: Lists the latest tracks (title, time since upload, duration) from a SoundCloud user's RSS feed. Accepts a profile URL, username or numeric ID; usernames are resolved to the numeric ID via oEmbed and cached. The RSS is fetched through the Misskey server's fetch-rss endpoint. No API key or login. Note: SoundCloud RSS only includes tracks whose creator enabled RSS (podcast) distribution, so many music accounts show nothing.
